piece.headline: ARORA TRIPLES UP AND SEIZES THE LEAD
piece.standfirst: Rajat Arora banks a Triple Captain on Haaland and goes top, with Yash Bhatia 11 points back.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora is top. Aryan Khamankar slips to third after a quiet week. Arora's Triple Captain on Haaland did the damage. Yash Bhatia sits 11 points back, so Arora can't relax.
piece.one_to_watch: The title race: Rajat Arora leads Yash Bhatia by 11. If Haaland keeps hauling and Yash finds a big week, that gap could vanish fast.

winners.name: Saeel
winners.verdict: Triple Captain on Haaland, 90 points and a 31-place leap. That is nerve paying off, and the best week in the league.

winners.name: Neol
winners.verdict: Calvert-Lewin and Manzambi came in and gave +18 on the swap. That is skill, and 4th place is the reward.

winners.name: Rajat Arora
winners.verdict: Triple Captain on Haaland and a seat at the top. Bold, brilliant, and he still left 13 points on the bench.

losers.name: Rohan
losers.verdict: Rogers wore the armband and returned 4. A grim week, but the league's worst score is not the whole story. Better days ahead.

losers.name: Pranav
losers.verdict: Pranav went solo on João Pedro. The captain's armband returned 4. Lonely, and the bench shrugged along with him.

losers.name: Kartik
losers.verdict: Rogers wore the armband and gave Rohan 4. Easy does it, because a week like that needs a hug more than a lecture.
